title: Tomorrow Will Be Insane: $1 Trillion Wiped Out
speaker: Tom and Mike (StockedUp hosts)

macro_themes.view: September CPI at 3.7% (core 2.6%) triggered a 1% S&P drop and ~40% odds of a Fed hike; volatility may just be beginning.
Growing concern over AI companies' debt (CoreWeave bond yields ~15%) is pressuring AI and growth stocks.
Houthi/Saudi and US-Iran escalation is causing historic energy supply disruption that should keep benefiting energy stocks.
Ten mostly-AI stocks drove 70% of the S&P's gain, and they now face a real test into earnings.
Money is rotating out of risky tech into consumer staples and healthcare.
